name: Backend API Test Coverage
description: Actionable tasks to implement the missing backend API tests referenced in docs/backend_api_test_coverage.md.

tasks.title: Account: cover /api/account/daily-summary
tasks.description: Add tests for the account daily summary endpoint, including cache hits, cache misses, and invalid query parameters.

tasks.title: API Docs: cover /api/docs/services
tasks.description: Write tests that validate the merged service catalog returned by /api/docs/services, stubbing dependent service clients as needed.

tasks.title: Config: cover module list/history/update/rollback endpoints
tasks.description: Implement tests for the config routes (REST and legacy aliases), including Redis success, permission errors, and rollback flows.

tasks.title: DOM: cover configuration, control, and alert endpoints
tasks.description: Ensure DOM routes are tested for reading/updating config, starting/stopping DOM streams, alert acknowledgements, and history snapshots.

tasks.title: Logs: cover listing/modules/stats endpoints
tasks.description: Add tests for log retrieval endpoints, including pagination, missing files, and stats aggregation branches.

tasks.title: Market Data: cover storage proxy and backfill
tasks.description: Test /market/storage and /market/backfill happy paths and error responses by stubbing MarketDataServiceClient interactions.

tasks.title: Monitoring: cover queue cache clearing
tasks.description: Cover the /api/monitoring/queues/clear-cache route for successful clears and Redis/flush exceptions.

tasks.title: Notifications: cover /api/notifications/test
tasks.description: Write tests verifying channel resolution and dispatch for the notifications test endpoint.

tasks.title: Runbooks: cover list/detail/start endpoints
tasks.description: Mock runbook_manager to cover retrieval, 404, and conflict responses for runbook routes.

tasks.title: Strategy: cover remaining CRUD and error paths
tasks.description: Extend strategy route tests to cover untested endpoints, payload validation, and service error handling.

tasks.title: Cleanup: remove outdated or dead route tests
tasks.description: Identify and delete tests that reference removed endpoints or obsolete behaviors while refactoring shared fixtures.

tasks.title: Documentation: update backend API coverage report
tasks.description: Refresh docs/backend_api_test_coverage.md with the new test coverage status after implementing the missing suites.

tasks.title: Verification: run focused and full pytest
tasks.description: Execute focused pytest runs for changed modules followed by the full test suite to confirm stability.
